Strings.TrayPilot 已经在运行，请从托盘打开现有窗口。: TrayPilot is already running. Open its window from the system tray.
Strings.Windows 托盘图标管理工具，支持隐藏规则、快捷管理和多语言。: Windows tray icon manager with hide rules, quick controls and multiple languages.
Strings.关闭窗口可保留在托盘运行；选择“退出”恢复隐藏图标并结束程序。: Closing the window can keep TrayPilot in the tray. Choose Exit to restore hidden icons and quit.
Strings.关闭窗口后保留在托盘运行: Keep running in the tray when the window closes
Strings.删除选中规则并恢复图标: Remove selected rules and restore icons
Strings.剪贴板暂不可用，请重试。: The clipboard is unavailable. Please try again.
Strings.单击显示此软件的所有托盘图标: Click to show all tray icons for this application
Strings.单击隐藏此软件的所有托盘图标: Click to hide all tray icons for this application
Strings.双击切换显示 / 隐藏；右键查看属性或结束任务。淡色表示隐藏，悬停查看详情。: Double-click to show or hide. Right-click for properties or End task. Faded icons are hidden; hover for details.
Strings.在输入框中按 Ctrl 或 Alt 加其他键。快捷键弹出快捷管理菜单，关闭主窗口: Press Ctrl or Alt plus another key in the field. This opens the quick-control menu, even when the main window is hidden.
Strings.已发送结束请求，但进程尚未退出，请稍后刷新。: The termination request was sent, but the process has not exited yet. Refresh later.
Strings.快捷键无效或已被占用，请更换组合。: The hotkey is invalid or already in use. Choose another combination.
Strings.快捷键注册失败，请在设置中更换组合。: Unable to register the hotkey. Choose another combination in Settings.
Strings.恢复记录已保留，请稍后重试关闭。: Recovery records were kept. Please try exiting again later.
Strings.托盘图标（√ 表示显示，单击切换）: Tray icons (checked = shown; click to toggle)
Strings.无法隐藏 {0}（ID={1}, GUID={2}），系统未确认隐藏状态。: Unable to hide {0} (ID={1}, GUID={2}). Windows did not confirm the hidden state.
Strings.此图标已失效，请刷新后重试。: This icon is no longer available. Refresh and try again.
Strings.自动刷新已关闭 · 可点击刷新手动检查: Auto-refresh is off · Click Refresh to update
Strings.让托盘只留下需要的图标: Keep only the tray icons you need
Strings.请先选择一个或多个软件（支持 Ctrl / Shift 多选）。: Select one or more applications (Ctrl / Shift for multiple selection).
Strings.请通过退出菜单结束 TrayPilot，以便恢复隐藏图标。: Use Exit to quit TrayPilot so hidden icons can be restored.
Strings.进程已退出或已变化，请刷新后重试。: The process has exited or changed. Refresh and try again.
